resolved_findings.finding: One private review slot owns archive/decoded data. Successful unstarted replacement invalidates the old reference only after validation; failed replacement preserves it. DiscardPreview requires exact ownership, clears memory only, and refuses Started&&!Completed. Started is set before exclusive directory creation is attempted; prepublication source/context failures and pre-existing collisions remain cancellable. Completed is set only after successful pointer/published-profile reconciliation. Every uncertainty cut preserves the exact same object, prohibits replacement/cancel, and retries to one profile/receipt without duplicate activation. Dispose drops retained review memory and releases the lease without deleting recovery evidence.
resolved_findings.memory_boundary: One persistent bounded review, not a fixed small process-memory guarantee. Validation may transiently allocate a second bounded archive; large allocations/GC behavior were not stress-tested.64 replacement cycles and64 cancel cycles inspect the actual private ownership slot.

resolved_findings.finding: Retained-stage retries require the exact expected checksummed import.owner envelope binding receipt/source/context before extraction or store recovery. Missing/checksum/receipt/source/context/renamed-foreign-stage variants all reject before writes with exact tree preservation. Published-profile uncertain retry validates owner and receipt before opening recovery-capable stores. Pre-existing stage/profile collisions are not adopted. This is a cooperating-process integrity boundary, not authentication against an attacker copying the expected owner envelope.

Confirmation accepts the exact owned object, never mutable summary/index/list fields. It rechecks active pointer context and both current/retained source hashes before publication, holds a FileShare.Read source lease through pointer publication, and extracts retained bytes only. Recovered destination session identity/flags/reveal state and full physical event history are compared. Original source ZIP/current profile remain intact; legacy single-save import preserves original schema1 bytes and repairs only the new profile.

Owned searches use hidden-holo name/collector number and a revealed-name positive control; every revealed prefix checks per-fullID quantities. Native06 passes these actual oracles.

resolved_findings.finding: 112 is an actual unique named-check count, not an assertion count. Independent valid-envelope prefix/sameRev physical conflicts and damaged prepared/anchor inputs exercise their real guards. ZIP mutations begin from a successfully opened valid archive. Matching but wrong local/central CRC fields pass structural checking and then fail the decoded CRC branch explicitly. Flags/encryption/descriptors, entry counts, names, disk/ZIP64/extras/comments, overlap/gaps/payload bounds, preamble/trailing, complete archive limit and aggregate uncompressed limit have real executed negatives. Aggregate test uses individually in-bound32MiB members and reaches the exact Oversized archive member branch before semantic decoding. No broader ZIP dialect or unrelated JSON-shape change was introduced.

test_gaps.gap: Short/partial exclusive-file writes, real sharing conflicts during collection extraction/receipt/pointer publication, and process loss while replacing an already-selected pointer are not covered. The legacy SessionStore does have real sharing/crash tests; that does not transfer coverage to CollectionProfiles. Partial owned files may require explicit recovery instead of automatic repair; no stronger guarantee is approved.

New native tests substantively improve hidden-name/number search and per-printing prefix checks, but do not combine every owned/missing/duplicates/holo filter with prior completed packs plus repeated IDs in one native scenario. Core projection remains sound on full inspection; this is remaining combinatorial coverage, not a demonstrated leak.

Fixtures manually Initialize and verify eventual lease release, not actual Unity Start scheduling/disposal-order observation. The final-table cue control has no bound media, so it does not establish real media pause/volume/stop/no-replay. Helper result-label assertions are not pixels/clicks. Candidate graphical/native process Quit/reopen, manifest, and user acceptance remain separate uninspected gates.

The runner now pins itself/ProjectVersion and refuses unexpected direct Editor/*.cs. It still does not retain a complete recursive stage membership/manifest pin, and the admission glob is nonrecursive. Exact47-input source matching is verified; a completely hermetic Unity project is not claimed.
